en: Lyrics and Signal: after a song at 44.1 or 48 kHz, a high-resolution one (88.2 to 192 kHz) froze the view's animation: the lyrics jumped once a second instead of scrolling, and the spectrum and read-outs stood still.
Lyrics: a track with no artist tag gets its lyrics online too, found by its title and length.

Archive: an album kept as one image file with a CUE sheet (WAV, FLAC or APE plus .cue) shows as its tracks, with the sheet's titles, artist and year, also when foobar2000's media library leaves the .cue files out.
zh: 歌词与信号视图：在 44.1 或 48 kHz 的歌曲之后播放高解析度歌曲（88.2 至 192 kHz）时，视图动画会停住：歌词每秒跳一次而不是平滑滚动，频谱和读数也不再更新。
歌词：没有艺术家标签的曲目现在也会在线获取歌词，按标题与时长匹配。
档案：以整轨文件加 CUE 分轨保存的专辑（WAV、FLAC 或 APE 加 .cue）现在按 CUE 分轨显示，带有其中的标题、艺术家与年份，即使 foobar2000 媒体库没有收录 .cue 文件。
